Water Walker is a puppetry experience that honors the nation’s first “freedom march” – The Igbo Landing of 1803. Through a fusion of shadow, tabletop, and rod puppetry, we follow one man’s journey from West Africa to the shores of Georgia—a profound exploration of resilience, agency, and the fight for freedom. URHERE
Ongoing
URHERE is a new one-of-a-kind, rigorously curated virtual platform for outdoor and digital premieres. URHERE aims to occupy an important part of the art ecosystem which nurtures experimentation, sparks dialogue, and creates engagement with the local community.
